atoms.text: Hey, Ana! It’s so nice to see you! Please come in!
Hi, Dhruv! It’s nice to see you too! So, what are we doing today?
atoms.sound: Hi, Droov! It’s nice to see you too! So, what are we doing today?

atoms.text: I’m not sure yet. How about we talk about the places we want to go to and make a plan?

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>I want to buy some bread. The bread at this place is really fresh and good.</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>I also need to buy a few bits, like pasta, milk, and nuts.</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>There are a few books that I want to borrow, and a few that I want to return.</voice>

instruction.text: Does Ana want to go to this place? Listen and choose.

atoms.a: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>I don’t want to eat bread today though. Is it ok if we don't go there?</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>Ok! We can do the shopping together!</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>I love being around books. Sure! Let’s go there!</voice>

atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>When the weather is nice, I like to sit under the trees and read or have a picnic.</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>We could watch the new science fiction film. My brother thinks that it's really good.</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_chirp'>I've heard that this place has great pasta. I think we should definitely give it a try.</voice>

instruction.text: Does Dhruv want to go to this place? Listen and choose.
instruction.sound: Does Droov want to go to this place? Listen and choose.

atoms.a: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>I love the park, but the weather isn’t so nice today. Let’s not go there.</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>I don’t know. It’s quite far away, and I don’t really like science fiction.</voice>
ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>Sure, I like pasta. Sounds like a good idea to me.</voice>

atoms.b: Alright, so our plan is to go to the supermarket, the restaurant and the library! ((++Where Who How)) do we want to go first?
The ((++restaurant supermarket library)) has to be last, of course, since we’re going there for dinner.
Good point. So, are we going to the supermarket or the library ((++first last between))?
Let’s go to the place that is ((++closer mirror herer)) first.

atoms.a: The restaurant they want to go to is on Quick Street, on the west side of the city.
The supermarket they want to go to is on the south side of Decent Street, across from Sun Park.
The library is on the east side of Silver Street.

atoms.b: The ((++library supermarket)) is closer to us, so let’s go there first.
Okay, let me get my keys and we can go.
atoms.sound: Okay... let me get my keys and we can go.
